facts.value: Certain deadlines are crucial for your path to the university. Knowing the dates allows for careful planning and avoidance of unnecessary hurdles.
The stated deadlines are exclusion deadlines. Applications or requests for enrollment submitted beyond these deadlines cannot be considered.
The following deadlines also apply for applications for higher semesters, second degrees, and changes of study programs.
Your higher education entrance qualification (HZB) must be completely available by the end of the application deadline. Preliminary certificates are not sufficient.
If you only receive your Abitur certificate after the deadline, you can only apply in the next application procedure.
In programs with nationwide restricted admission (Medicine, Dentistry, Pharmacy), applications are made through the Foundation for University Admissions.
Enrollment must be completed by the deadline specified in the admission notice or on the Goethe-Campus.
Please pay particular attention to the documents required for enrollment, which must be sent or uploaded on time.
Make sure to transfer the semester fee in a timely manner.
